The candidate targets a broad range of solid tumors, with Bristol-Myers Squibb preparing for potential clinical development and future commercialization. Separately, Bristol-Myers Squibb is expanding its Standing in the Gaap program in multiple myeloma, launching a survey to better understand care barriers and inequities...
